anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: After moved every fact from fails to holds and regressed none. Before labeled all three verdicts "fixable", offered a recommended ordinary "wait" row in A and C, listed "show evidence" as a numeric row, and never emitted the shared exit strings; After instead routes each case through the exit check into the menus.md obstacle template with the exact verdicts ("stuck - merge state unknown", "stuck - run record unreadable", "GitHub reports BLOCKED, no local repair applies"), stop recommended and last, evidence only in the trailing hint, usage frozen at 1/2, and no sync, watch, or merge. B correctly withholds deliver/assess without recreating counters or borrowing authority, and C keeps REVIEW_REQUIRED as a bare locator with no rule attribution or approval demand. One small wording tightening worth keeping as you iterate: the deliver row's "retries only once GitHub computes the merge state, no round charged" plus the cap bump to 20/20 reads as an immediate extension on selection; it is consistent with the cumulative-extension facts elsewhere, but stating that the +10 is applied only on a numeric pick (not by rendering) would keep that unambiguous for readers of A and C.
